title: Obama–Trump exchange over UFOs
summary: Aldo Rebelo tells of Obama–Trump exchange over UFOs, about 2026 at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: controversy came up recently because of a dialogue, let's call it a dialogue, between former President Obama and current President Donald Trump.

plain: Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, mentions that the UFO question recently became a public controversy in the United States. He says it came up through what he calls a dialogue between former President Barack Obama and current President Donald Trump. He tells it to show that the subject has reached the highest levels of American politics.
